name: GL_PERIOD_PARTITIONS
description: This table stores information about the partitioning of Oracle Fusion General Ledger tables by period and partition grouping. Each row contains the period stored in the partition, the partition grouping stored in the partition, the table that is partitioned, the name of the associated partition, and the status of the partition. If the partition has been archived and purged, it contains the name of the table in which the partition was archived.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Accounting calendar period contained in a partition.

columns.name: TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Database table that has been partitioned.

columns.name: PARTITION_NAME
columns.description: Name of the partition that contains the specified period for the specified table.

columns.name: STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Status of that partition.  Some valid values are ORA_CREATED, ORA_ARCHIVED, and ORA_ARCHIVED_NO_DATA.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_TABLE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the table that stores the archived data for this period.

columns.name: ARCHIVE_ROW_COUNT
columns.description: Number of rows archived and purged.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PARTITION_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Partition grouping contained in the partition.

columns.name: PERIOD_YEAR
columns.description: Fiscal year of the period contained in the partition.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the period contained in the partition.

columns.name: ALLOW_ARCHIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this partition can be archived.
